## Key content decisions

- **Closure.** The design's 13 A claims and 5 B claims are kept; the A page adds the weight/L^p(w)/cube conventions, ball-cube maximal comparability, the A_1 cube-form equivalence, the weighted-average/density-to-mass lemma, the fixed-cube dyadic machinery, the weighted maximal function and its weak (1,1), the A_∞↔power-decay halves, the doubling-weight differentiation lemma, the general reverse-Hölder lemma, and the good-λ/well-definedness inputs. 31/100 items — no split needed.
- **Choice ledger.** Countable Choice throughout; Dependent Choice only in the four items using C_c-density in L^p(w). The Axiom-of-Choice route through the published measure-differentiation theorem was avoided; no path reaches `deferred-set-theory-beyond-choice`.
- **Recorded conflicts.** (1) Plan/design "Radon–Nikodym facts": the page consumes the required Radon page's regularity/density items but no RN density — the RN pair is not an actual prerequisite. (2) Design row numbering is irregular; all 13 claims are mapped by ID. (3) The weighted CZ theorem is stated for `T*, T**` with an explicit dense-class a.e.-convergence clause for `T`, because general library CZ operators need not have principal values; Hilbert/Riesz are fully covered. (4) Design row 10 was split into forward (CC) and converse (DC) lemmas plus the synthesis theorem, to keep the weighted CZ chain free of the converse machinery.
